title: Zoom Bugs and Xbox Leaks

slides.headline: Zoom Bugs and Xbox Leaks
slides.subtitle: Catch up on today's top five tech stories in under a minute.

slides.headline: A Scary Zoom Security Flaw
slides.explanation: Researchers found a bug that let people on a Zoom call take control of other participants' devices. The issue has since been fixed, but it shows how easily AI tools can spot vulnerabilities.

slides.headline: Is This the New Xbox Controller?
slides.explanation: A Reddit user claims they bought a prototype Xbox Elite Series 3 controller on a resale site. The device appears to feature a built-in screen, hinting at what Microsoft might release next.

slides.headline: Sonos Headphones Incoming
slides.explanation: New FCC filings suggest Sonos is preparing to launch a follow-up to its Ace headphones this fall. This aligns with recent comments from the company's leadership about upcoming hardware.

slides.headline: Chrome's New Security Upgrade
slides.explanation: Google is testing a new way to protect Chrome users from hackers hijacking their accounts. This method uses device-bound credentials to make your login sessions much harder to steal.

slides.headline: Threads Lands on VR Headsets
slides.explanation: Meta just launched a dedicated Threads app for its Quest VR headsets. It is the latest step in Meta's plan to get the platform onto all its hardware products.

title: Zambia Votes and Global Power Shifts

slides.headline: Zambia Votes and Global Power Shifts
slides.subtitle: Five quick updates on the world news you need to know today.

slides.headline: Zambia heads to the polls
slides.explanation: Zambia is holding a presidential election this Thursday. As a nation rich in critical minerals, the result could influence global supply chains.

slides.headline: Stephen Curry's future in Golden State
slides.explanation: The Warriors general manager says there are strong signs Stephen Curry will finish his career with the team. It is a major update for NBA fans watching the star's legacy.

slides.headline: Fever keep the win streak alive
slides.explanation: The Indiana Fever defeated the Liberty 106-92 behind big performances from Kelsey Mitchell and Caitlin Clark. The team is currently on a hot streak in the WNBA.

slides.headline: NZ Prime Minister survives vote
slides.explanation: Prime Minister Christopher Luxon confirmed he survived a leadership vote within his own party. It is a key moment for stability in New Zealand's current government.

slides.headline: US returns to sanctions on Iran
slides.explanation: Trump is shifting back to sanctions on Iran after other negotiation strategies stalled. The move comes as US weapon stockpiles have started to dwindle.
